latin: Licet ita mihi uideatur probabile, non est tamen pertinaciter asserendum quod anima Christi per alium modum nobis ignotum non potuerit in infernum descendere.
latin_note: 1486 reads '...ignotum potuerit...'; the Emendationes errorum corrects this to 'non potuerit', which 1487 follows. The negation is essential to the sense and is kept.
translation: Though it strikes me as probable, one should not stubbornly insist that the soul of Christ could not have descended into hell by some other way unknown to us.
translation_note: The Latin marks this as Pico's own probable view, explicitly withheld from firm assertion; pico_stance recorded as unstated on that basis.
